tool_args.rationale: The monotone concave pilot has sink-gradient signatures, but all five points lie below the reported supercritical threshold. The high-gradient probe tests whether an avalanche term emerges in the forecast regime.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the ordinary siphon model immediately
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The pilot reaches s_grad 2.44, just below the archived avalanche threshold range, so it cannot identify a supercritical branch.
The observed signatures do not specifically identify a coupled memory ODE, and the high-gradient probe directly tests the consequential threshold ambiguity.
It does not resolve the threshold mechanism.
